name: Monk
tools: Choose one type of artisan's tools or one musical instrument
equipment: (a) a shortsword or (b) any simple weapon
(a) a dungeoneer's pack or (b) an explorer's pack

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Martial Arts: bonus action strike after the Attack action

actions.name: Flurry of Blows
actions.desc: 1 ki, bonus action after Attack: two unarmed strikes

actions.name: Step of the Wind
actions.desc: 1 ki, bonus action: Disengage or Dash, jump distance doubled

actions.name: Stunning Strike
actions.desc: 1 ki on a hit: CON save DC {dc:WIS} or stunned until your next turn

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.desc: No armor or shield: AC 10 + DEX + WIS.

1.name: Martial Arts
1.desc: Unarmed or with monk weapons, no armor or shield: DEX for attacks and damage, the martial arts die (d4, growing) as damage, and a bonus action unarmed strike after the Attack action.

2.name: Ki
2.desc: Ki points equal to monk level, back after a short rest (30 min meditation): Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind; save DC 8 + prof + WIS.

2.name: Unarmored Movement
2.desc: +10 ft speed without armor or shield, growing with level; from 9th level run on walls and water during your move.

3.name: Deflect Missiles
3.desc: Reaction when hit by a ranged weapon: reduce damage by 1d10 + DEX + monk level; at 0, catch it and spend 1 ki to throw it back (20/60).

4.name: Slow Fall
4.desc: Reaction: reduce falling damage by 5 x monk level.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.desc: On a melee weapon hit, 1 ki: CON save or stunned through your next turn.

7.name: Evasion
7.desc: DEX saves for half damage: none on a success, half on a failure.

7.name: Stillness of Mind
7.desc: Action: end a charmed or frightened effect on yourself.

9.name: Unarmored Movement improvement
9.desc: Move along vertical surfaces and across liquids during your turn.

13.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
13.desc: Understand all spoken languages and be understood by anyone who speaks one.

14.name: Diamond Soul
14.desc: Proficiency in all saves; spend 1 ki to reroll a failed save.

15.name: Timeless Body
15.desc: No frailty of age, no magical aging, no need for food or water.

18.name: Empty Body
18.desc: Action, 4 ki: invisible and resistant to all but force damage for 1 min. 8 ki: Astral Projection on yourself without material.

20.name: Perfect Self
20.desc: Regain 4 ki when you roll initiative with none left.

3.name: Draconic Disciple
3.desc: Unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison; reaction reroll of a failed Intimidation or Persuasion (once per long rest when it works); learn Draconic.

3.name: Breath of the Dragon
3.desc: Replace one attack with a 20 ft cone or 30 ft line: DEX save, two martial arts dice of a chosen element (three at 11th); prof bonus uses per long rest, then 2 ki each.

6.name: Wings Unfurled
6.desc: With Step of the Wind, fly at your walking speed until your turn ends (prof bonus/long rest).

11.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
11.desc: Bonus action, 10 ft aura for 1 min: frighten a creature each turn (WIS save), or give allies resistance to one element; once per long rest or 3 ki.

17.name: Ascendant Aspect
17.desc: 1 ki: Breath of the Dragon becomes a 60 ft cone or 90 ft line for four martial arts dice; blindsight 10 ft; Explosive Fury: when Aspect of the Wyrm starts, creatures within 10 ft DEX save or take four martial arts dice.

3.name: Arms of the Astral Self
3.desc: Bonus action, 1 ki: spectral arms for 10 min (creatures within 10 ft DEX save or two martial arts dice of force); WIS for STR checks, unarmed strikes with 10 ft reach using WIS, force damage.

6.name: Visage of the Astral Self
6.desc: 1 ki, 10 min: see 120 ft in any darkness, advantage on Insight and Intimidation, speak to one creature only or boom to 600 ft.

11.name: Body of the Astral Self
11.desc: With arms and visage out: reaction to reduce elemental or force damage by 1d10 + WIS, and once per turn +1 martial arts die on an arms hit.

17.name: Awakened Astral Self
17.desc: Bonus action, 5 ki: full astral self for 10 min, +2 AC and three attacks with Extra Attack if all use the arms.

3.name: Drunken Technique
3.desc: Flurry of Blows also grants Disengage and +10 ft speed this turn.

6.name: Tipsy Sway
6.desc: Stand from prone for 5 ft; reaction, 1 ki: a melee miss on you hits another creature within 5 ft of you.

11.name: Drunkard's Luck
11.desc: 2 ki: cancel disadvantage on a check, attack or save.

17.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
17.desc: Flurry of Blows makes up to five attacks if each hits a different creature.

3.name: Disciple of the Elements
3.desc: Elemental Attunement plus one discipline (one more at 6th, 11th and 17th); disciplines spend ki for elemental effects or spells, with a ki cap per spell that grows with level.

3.name: Path of the Kensei
3.desc: Two kensei weapons (one melee, one ranged, no heavy or special) count as monk weapons; Agile Parry (+2 AC after an unarmed strike), Kensei's Shot (+1d4 ranged damage), calligraphy or painter's tools.

6.name: One with the Blade
6.desc: Kensei weapons are magical; once per turn, 1 ki for +martial arts die damage on a hit.

11.name: Sharpen the Blade
11.desc: Bonus action, up to 3 ki: a kensei weapon gets that bonus to hit and damage for 1 min.

17.name: Unerring Accuracy
17.desc: Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.

3.name: Touch of Death
3.desc: Dropping a creature within 5 ft to 0 HP gives you WIS + monk level temp HP.

6.name: Hour of Reaping
6.desc: Action: creatures within 30 ft that see you WIS save or frightened until your next turn ends.

11.name: Mastery of Death
11.desc: Dropped to 0 HP: spend 1 ki to stay at 1.

17.name: Touch of the Long Death
17.desc: Action, touch, 1-10 ki: CON save, 2d10 necrotic per ki (half on a success).

3.name: Implements of Mercy
3.desc: Insight, Medicine, herbalism kit and a mercy mask.

3.name: Hands of Healing
3.desc: Action, 1 ki: heal martial arts die + WIS; one Flurry strike can be a free heal instead.

3.name: Hands of Harm
3.desc: Once per turn on an unarmed hit, 1 ki: + martial arts die + WIS necrotic.

6.name: Physician's Touch
6.desc: Hands of Healing also ends a disease or blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned; Hands of Harm can poison until your next turn ends.

11.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
11.desc: Flurry of Blows strikes can be free Hands of Healing, and Hands of Harm costs no ki on them (still once per turn).

17.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
17.desc: Action, 5 ki: revive a creature dead under 24 h with 4d10 + WIS HP, curing some conditions; once per long rest.

3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.desc: Flurry of Blows hits can knock prone (DEX save), push 15 ft (STR save) or deny reactions until your next turn.

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.desc: Action: heal 3 x monk level, once per long rest.

11.name: Tranquility
11.desc: After a long rest you are under Sanctuary (DC 8 + prof + WIS) until the next.

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.desc: 3 ki on an unarmed hit: later an action triggers it, CON save or drop to 0 HP, 10d10 necrotic on a success.

3.name: Shadow Arts
3.desc: 2 ki: Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace or Silence, no material needed; Minor Illusion cantrip.

6.name: Shadow Step
6.desc: Bonus action from dim light or darkness: teleport 60 ft to another such spot, advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

11.name: Cloak of Shadows
11.desc: Action in dim light or darkness: invisible until you attack, cast, or enter bright light.

17.name: Opportunist
17.desc: Reaction: melee attack on a creature within 5 ft that someone else just hit.

3.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
3.desc: Ranged spell attack 30 ft with DEX, martial arts die radiant, usable in the Attack action; 1 ki for two more as a bonus action.

6.name: Searing Arc Strike
6.desc: After the Attack action, 2 ki: Burning Hands as a bonus action, +1 level per extra ki (total up to half monk level).

11.name: Searing Sunburst
11.desc: Action: 20 ft sphere within 150 ft, CON save or 2d6 radiant, +2d6 per ki spent (max 3).

17.name: Sun Shield
17.desc: Shed light 30 ft; reaction to deal 5 + WIS radiant to a creature hitting you in melee.
